body:
A distinct bounded read-only recovery route closed the previously unavailable shadow-copy metadata coverage gap. It did not recover the original July tapes/manifests/comparator.

One owned, nonrecursive NT Device-directory query found three actual HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy device names. A second owned metadata query inspected only those three saved current-user Desktop paths and their named Sirius directories, checking every ancestor for reparse points before descent. **All three saved Sirius directories are readable and empty**: each enumeration saw only dot/dotdot before the native end-of-files result. No image or manifest content was found/read, and directory last-write timestamps are not snapshot creation dates.

Both Windows births and WSL owners retired, input seals held and independent saved-result audits passed. No mounting, elevation, recursive/global scan, cloud hydration, Add-Type/csc child compilation or restore occurred. The original failed CIM/vssadmin routes were never interpreted as evidence that snapshots did not exist.

[Exact query sources, raw metadata, ownership and reviews](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/f851c664135b2fdd579cc8daab4eecf6036c84ef/attestations/forensic/5b2df58b/july-snapshot-desktop-route/manifest.json) are committed and pushed as f851c664, tag evidence/packed-scratch-and-july-snapshots-5b2df58b. This selected route is exhausted; no concrete new location emerged to justify another broad search. The three completed NEW_RECONSTRUCTION pairs remain separately labelled. The user's No clue answer does not waive original identity, and #100 stays open. Rendering/scientific work continues independently.
